lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance blobs are organized into four primary horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with spacing increasing toward the caudal section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows, forming a semi-regular grid where the largest blobs are located at the nodes of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light-reflecting upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately five high-luminance spots are visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, predominantly distributed along the lower and posterior edges of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density arrangement of smaller-diameter spots compared to the larger blobs located on the lateral flank.
